_doc: FL1 (src/foliage.cpp greenery, src/render.cpp greenGrade): the leaves of the temperate maps toward the spring green of the user's reference (ambientCG DayEnvironmentHDRI078: shaded canopy sRGB 0.46 0.55 0.15, hue 74, sunlit 0.73 0.79 0.54; never olive or blue-green). Only pixels that are green already move (dry, autumn, dead leaves, bark, succulents and the ivy stay); each keeps its own shading. target: the card leaves' and grass's colour (sRGB albedo); cardStrength / grassStrength: how far they move (0 off), cardGain / grassGain: their brightness. species: model foliage by bake dir prefix, leaf = that species' target (sRGB albedo), lum = its leaf texture's mean linear luminance (the gain is target / lum), modelStrength how far, jitter per instance. Read at startup; arid maps get none.
